title: Google's Strongest Gemini 4 Pro Begins Testing with Impressive SVG Image Generation
excerpt: According to netizens' feedback, Google is testing its strongest model Gemini4Pro, named "gemini-3.8-flash," on benchmark platforms like Arena. The internal dev
content_html:
According to netizens' feedback, Google is testing its strongest model Gemini4Pro, named "gemini-3.8-flash," on benchmark platforms like Arena. The internal development codename is Argon. Using an old version number for testing is a typical "quietly honing skills" strategy.

In the test images shared by netizens, the most eye-catching is the classic problem—generating an SVG image of a "pelican riding a bicycle." Gemini4Pro's output was evaluated as very excellent, and the poster specifically brought in OpenAI's strongest model, GPT-6Astra Pro, for comparison on the same topic. SVG, a vector format, is the most challenging for models in terms of understanding structure, paths, and geometric relationships. Being able to draw a well-fitted combination of a pelican and a bicycle indicates that its capabilities in graphic generation should not be underestimated.

Netizens believe that once Google officially releases Gemini4Pro, its capabilities will take another step forward—after all, the testing version is not yet the complete version. Google has not officially announced this model yet.
